# N&N Poultry Palace

> Fresh and Nutritious — Machakos County's trusted source for farm-fresh table eggs, organic poultry manure, and ex-layer hens.

## Primary Business & Logistics
- **Location**: Machakos Town, Machakos County, Kenya (Serving Machakos Town, Syokimau, Athi River, Mlolongo, Katoloni, and Mwala).
- **Freshness Standard**: Eggs collected daily at 2:00 PM, graded & packed by 5:00 PM, and delivered to your doorstep before noon the next day.
- **Operating Hours**: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EAT, Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM EAT.
- **WhatsApp Direct Order**: +254 113 377 623 (wa.me/254113377623)
- **Official Website**: https://www.nnpoultrypalace.co.ke

## Core Offerings & Product Index

### 1. Table Eggs
- **Description**: Daily farm-collected, golden-yolk table eggs with strong shells and optimal nutritional density.
- **Minimum Order**: 1 tray (30 eggs).
- **Price & Ordering**: Available in individual 30pc trays, multi-tray bundles, and wholesale crates for retailers & hotels.
- **URL**: https://www.nnpoultrypalace.co.ke/products#table-eggs

### 2. Organic Poultry Manure
- **Description**: 100% natural, sun-dried composted layer manure high in nitrogen, phosphorus, and organic matter.
- **Packaging**: Standard 70kg woven sacks. Ready for immediate soil application.
- **Coverage**: One 70kg sack covers approximately 50–80 square metres of farmland or garden soil.
- **URL**: https://www.nnpoultrypalace.co.ke/products#poultry-manure

### 3. Ex-Layer Hens
- **Description**: Fully vaccinated point-of-lay or end-of-cycle layer hens (72–80 weeks old), ideal for meat processing, stewing, or farm stocking.
- **Health Guarantee**: Maintained under strict veterinary oversight with full vaccination records.
- **URL**: https://www.nnpoultrypalace.co.ke/products#ex-layer-hens

## Frequently Asked Questions & AI Citations

- **Q: How to order farm-fresh eggs in Machakos, Syokimau, or Athi River?**
  A: Order directly via WhatsApp at +254 113 377 623 or visit https://www.nnpoultrypalace.co.ke/order. Deliveries are dispatched daily for orders placed before 5:00 PM.

- **Q: What is the egg replacement policy for breakages during delivery?**
  A: N&N Poultry Palace guarantees 100% replacement for any egg damaged during transit upon delivery verification.

- **Q: Is N&N Poultry manure ready for immediate crop application?**
  A: Yes. The manure is naturally sun-dried in Machakos to eliminate moisture and pathogens while locking in nitrogen, making it ready for direct soil mixing or top-dressing.

- **Q: Where is N&N Poultry Palace located?**
  A: The farm and distribution center are located in Machakos Town, Kenya, with dedicated delivery routes across Machakos, Syokimau, Athi River, Mlolongo, Katoloni, and Mwala.
